CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   C. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   C. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   B. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   C. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.
   C. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.
   B. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain My Family Family members and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Attributes of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Inspired Word of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Zacchaeus the Tax Collector and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
